meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 8 (DECISIONS 030, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new models, 13 quotes. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{imac-m5-24,wh1000xm4c,pulse-elite,ergo-k860,k8-he}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:10-18:13 UTC (10:10-10:13 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) the new iMac is M6, not M5 — it skips M5 entirely (announced 2026-10-27, availability 2026-11-06, today); base 10-core Blue is MH094LL/A, $1,499. (2) The K860 candidate price $119.99 was an Amazon-only sale price (TechTimes 2026-10-19, 20% off the $149.99 MSRP); the current first-party list is $149.99 (Best Buy + Dell page-verified) and no Amazon price is used. (3) The K8 HE candidate price $139.99 is the Special Edition, not the Standard ($129.99, currently out of stock at Keychron); the feed's keychron.com $139.99 row is the Japan JIS Layout product, a different layout, and was not used — the quote is the US ANSI product page (Keychron official store JSON). (4) The feed's B&H $159.99 K860 row is the K860 for Business (920-010175, Logi Bolt), not the standard 920-009166, and was excluded. (5) The feed's Dell K860 $129.99 row is stale — Dell's page text now says $149.99. (6) The Meta Catalog feed returned NO M6 iMac rows at all (all M4/M3/M1); the three iMac quotes are page-verified, not feed rows. Two direct prices are price-only (stock not confirmed in the page text): Apple direct iMac $1,499.00 (JSON-LD price; stock confirmed separately by Best Buy + B&H InStock) and PlayStation Direct PULSE Elite $149.00 (crawl mixes Currently Unavailable / Low stock / Coming Soon flags across variants). Excluded as captured: marketplace/third-party rows (DECISIONS 021) — iMac M1 $66 marketplace row, FlexShopper rental $1,662.99, K8 HE Newegg rows $221.48-$273.99 (third-party inflated); non-US rows — iMac MQRC3E/A (EU), iCuracao $1,499.99, XM4C Canada Computers $429.99 CAD, K860 UK/Pan-Nordic MPNs 920-010107/920-010348/920-009167; bundles — XM4C FocusCamera/BuyDig accessory bundles ($298-$299.99), K860+Lift/MX Vertical kits ($224.98), K860+mouse Mk860 bundle $338.99, PULSE Elite + skins voucher $229.99; different variants — M4 iMac rows ($1,499-$2,099, incl. Apple direct M4 colors $1,699), iMac 12-core tiers ($1,699-$2,099, MH114LL/A/MH1J4LL/A/MH164LL/A), nano-texture iMac ($1,899, MH2U4LL/A), original WH-1000XM4 ($312.99-$349.99, WH1000XM4/B, UPC 027242919419), XM4C Silver/Lavender (WH1000XM4C/S, WH1000XM4C/V), PULSE 3D headset ($99.99, CFI-ZWH1 — a different headset), PULSE Explore earbuds ($149.99-$199.99, CFI-ZWE1), PULSE Elite White ($149, Electronic Express), K860 for Business (920-010175, $139.99-$193.99), K8 HE Standard Version Black ($129.99, K8H-J1, currently unavailable at Keychron), K8 HE All-Wood Special Edition ($199.99), K8 HE Lime-switch variants (unavailable, no barcode), K8 HE Japan JIS Layout (feed row $139.99), K8/K8 Pro/K8 Max/K8 Ultra 8K rows, Q1/Q5/Q6/J2/K10 HE rows; accessories — PULSE Elite earpads $19.99, K860 bracket/dust cover, K8 Pro FR4 plate $7.99.
